# Outkast Studios

Outkast Studios is a Creative Growth Studio based in Uttarakhand, India.

We build brands that get noticed, digital experiences that build trust, and creative campaigns that move businesses forward.

## Services

- Brand Building: Brand identity, visual direction, positioning and storytelling.
- AI Advertising: AI UGC advertisements, product films, promotional videos and creative campaigns.
- Website Development: Portfolio websites, business websites and conversion-focused landing pages.
- Social Media Management: Content calendars, Reels, creative production and account management.
- Meta Ads: Facebook and Instagram advertising, campaign management and performance optimisation.

## Service Areas

- Primary: Haridwar, Uttarakhand, India
- Primary: Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India
- National: India (remote projects)
- International: Available for select international projects
